name: Lençóis Maranhenses
blurb: Lençóis Maranhenses National Park in northeastern Brazil features vast white sand dunes that fill with seasonal rainwater lagoons. Online discussion notes potential visitor entry limits due to rising tourist numbers.

positive: Surreal and unique landscape of dunes and water
Great destination for hiking and trekking trips
Incredible views during sunset and daytime
negative: Potential upcoming limits on visitor entry and tourism
